# Protocol inventory

This inventory follows the checked-in **codex-cli 0.167.0** schema, including experimental APIs. Every listed method is typed at the client boundary; availability depends on the running Codex server and its configuration.

Run `npm run generate:rpc` after schema regeneration. `npm run check:rpc` detects documentation drift without launching Codex.

| --- | ---: | --- |
| Client requests | 183 | `request(method, params)` |
| Server notifications | 88 | `onNotification(method, listener)` |
| Server requests | 11 | `onServerRequest(method, handler)` |
